description:
You are an environmental microbiologist studying microbial communities in contaminated groundwater. You need to design PCR primers that specifically amplify the 16S rRNA gene from sulfate-reducing bacteria (SRB) — key organisms in bioremediation of heavy metal contamination. Your primer set must be specific to the Desulfovibrio/Desulfobulbus clade while excluding common soil bacteria.

The data files are at ~/UGENE_Data/environmental/:
- srb_16S_sequences.fasta: 16S rRNA gene sequences from 8 sulfate-reducing bacteria species (target group)
- nontarget_16S_sequences.fasta: 16S rRNA gene sequences from 6 common non-target soil bacteria
- all_16S_combined.fasta: All 14 sequences combined for alignment

Perform the following analysis in UGENE:

1. Open all_16S_combined.fasta and load all 14 sequences as an alignment.

2. Perform a multiple sequence alignment using Kalign (a fast algorithm suitable for rRNA sequences). If Kalign is unavailable, use T-Coffee or any available algorithm.

3. After alignment, identify a variable region (V3-V4 hypervariable region, approximately positions 340-800 in the alignment) where the SRB sequences share a conserved motif that differs from the non-target sequences. This is the primer binding site.

4. Use UGENE's Primer3 tool (Analyze menu > Primer3 or Actions > Primer3) to design a primer pair targeting the SRB-specific conserved region. Configure:
   - Product size range: 200-500 bp
   - Primer Tm: 55-65°C
   - Primer length: 18-25 bp

5. Save the alignment in FASTA format as ~/UGENE_Data/environmental/results/srb_alignment.fasta

6. Save the designed primers in a text file ~/UGENE_Data/environmental/results/primer_design.txt with:
   - Forward primer sequence and Tm
   - Reverse primer sequence and Tm
   - Expected amplicon size
   - Target region coordinates

7. Create an analysis report at ~/UGENE_Data/environmental/results/primer_specificity_report.txt describing:
   - Which variable region was selected and why
   - How the primers discriminate SRB from non-target organisms
   - Expected specificity assessment
   - Recommended PCR conditions (annealing temperature, cycle count)

metadata.data_source: NCBI 16S rRNA sequences: SRB targets - PV992576.1 (D. vulgaris), PV110867.1 (D. desulfuricans), NR_117122.1 (D. giganteus), PX448252.1 (Db. propionicus), NR_122091.1 (D. africanus), PP977854.1 (D. piger), PX240737.1 (Dm. baculatum), PP882851.1 (Db. postgatei). Non-targets - PV810134.1 (E. coli), PZ050675.1 (B. subtilis), PZ049890.1 (P. aeruginosa), PZ050804.1 (S. aureus), PZ028441.1 (S. coelicolor), PZ049452.1 (C. butyricum)
